verdict.rationale: VLP's Emerging Growth & VC pages describe formation, seed/convertible/VC financings and investor-side counsel, but nothing about international investors, flips or redomiciliations, or multi-jurisdiction financings. The firm's other international references are not about cross-border venture work: foreign trademark filings under the Madrid Protocol, GDPR/PIPEDA privacy advice, and clients in 'varied global industries.'
